say:1:1510419001:0.text: <style="highlight">Regulus Abundius</style> has agreed to meet with you all.

say:2:1510419002:0.text: You've seen the current situation in Halia. What do you think?
say:2:1510419002:0.source_cn: 你们已经亲眼见到呼临城的现状，有何感觉？
say:2:1510419002:0.male: You've seen the current situation in Halia. What do you think?
say:2:1510419002:0.female: You've seen the current situation in Halia. What do you think?

choice_prompt:3:1510419002.text: You've seen the current situation in Halia. What do you think?
choice_prompt:3:1510419002.source_cn: 你们已经亲眼见到呼临城的现状，有何感觉？
choice_prompt:3:1510419002.male: You've seen the current situation in Halia. What do you think?
choice_prompt:3:1510419002.female: You've seen the current situation in Halia. What do you think?

say:4:1510419003:0.text: Well, our forefathers didn't think it was dangerous.
say:4:1510419003:0.male: Well, our forefathers didn't think it was dangerous.
say:4:1510419003:0.female: Well, our forefathers didn't think it was dangerous.

say:5:1510419006:0.text: We must find a way to help Halia survive.

say:6:1510419007:0.text: War is a one-way road to oblivion, and there's no turning back. Just endless bloodshed for both sides.
say:6:1510419007:0.source_cn: 战争是一条踏上就无法回头的绝路，只会让双方无谓流血。

say:7:1510419008:0.text: If there is another way, I will do everything in my power to avoid an all-out war with the Wildborn.
say:7:1510419008:0.source_cn: 如果有别的路可选，我会尽力避免和雅库伯尔全面开战。

say:8:1510419009:0.text: I hope you'll keep your word and save Halia.
say:8:1510419009:0.source_cn: 希望你们也能实现自己的承诺：用魔法解除诅咒，拯救呼临城。

say:10:1510419010:0.text: Maybe that sand-filled brain of yours isn't useless after all.
say:10:1510419010:0.source_cn: 嗯……看来你脖子上那颗海藻脑袋不是摆设。有点见地。

say:11:1510419011:1.text: At least you're better than that loud annoying lieutenant leading us around earlier.
say:11:1510419011:1.source_cn: 比那个只会嚷嚷的副将强多了。

say:12:1510419012:0.text: ... When we meet the Regulus, you should keep your mouth shut.

say:13:1510419013:1.text: Fine, I don't feel like arguing anyway.

say:16:1510419014:1.text: We'll do all we can to persuade Abundius to permit the use of magic so that we might prevent this war before it begins.
say:16:1510419014:1.source_cn: 我们会尽力说服阿邦德，用魔法消弭未起的战争。

say:17:1510419015:0.text: For the sake of Halia, its citizens, and the lives of the Wildborn... we must stand united, Perseus.
say:17:1510419015:0.source_cn: 为了呼临城，也为了雅库伯尔的生灵……让我们共同努力吧，...

say:20:1510419017:0.text: Follow me. The Regulus has been waiting for us.
say:20:1510419017:0.source_cn: 跟我来，领主已经等候多时。

choice:3:0:1.text: Halia is built on a dangerous cliff.
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 呼临城的确立于危崖上
choice:3:0:1.male: Halia is built on a dangerous cliff.
choice:3:0:1.female: Halia is built on a dangerous cliff.

say:22:1510419004:0.text: Yes, we need to help them.
say:22:1510419004:0.male: Yes, we need to help them.
say:22:1510419004:0.female: Yes, we need to help them.

say:23:1510419005:0.text: I've never heard of a city by that name...
say:23:1510419005:0.source_cn: 没听过叫那种名字的城镇。
say:23:1510419005:0.male: I've never heard of a city by that name...
say:23:1510419005:0.female: I've never heard of a city by that name...

choice:3:2:3.source_cn: 圣石镇比你们所谓的“城邦”强多了
